stencil.name: Letter with a secret
stencil.desc: An ordinary letter and a brass stencil: lay it straight and the secret shows through the windows

field.coverHint: An innocent letter: “Dear Auntie, the harvest is fine this year…” The phrase letters are found in it in order.
field.phraseHint: What shows through the windows. For example: The castle falls at dawn
field.widthTip: Characters per line of the letter, 20 to 60. Empty — chosen by the letter length (about 34).

problem.noCover: Write the letter: ordinary text to hide the phrase in.
problem.noPhrase: Type the secret phrase: its letters will be found in the letter.
problem.missingFirst: The letter has no “{letter}”, the first letter of the phrase. Add to the letter.
problem.missing: After “{after}” there is no “{letter}” left in the letter. Add to the letter: this letter is needed closer to the end.
problem.unknown: The letter could not be built. Check the text and the phrase.

view.plateAria: Stencil. Drag to move; arrows move it, Enter puts it in place.
